topic: What If the Internet Shut Down for a Week?
header: What if the internet shut down?

beats.narration: If the internet shut down tomorrow, you couldn't buy groceries... and it's not because the shops are closed.

shots.scene_description: Checkout card terminal flashing ERROR
Shop with OPEN sign, CARD DECLINED stamp

beats.narration: Most card payments need the internet to check with your bank. So suddenly, cash is the only thing that works, and most people barely carry any.

shots.scene_description: Card to bank connection breaking
Empty wallet, CASH ONLY sign

beats.narration: Shops order their stock through computer networks too. Within days, shelves would start running low.

shots.scene_description: Stock order screen with error
Supermarket shelves emptying

beats.narration: Your phone would turn into a very expensive flashlight. No messages, no videos, no social media.

shots.scene_description: Phone with no-connection spinner and greyed apps
Man using phone as a flashlight in the dark

beats.narration: But here's something surprising. Your GPS would still know exactly where you are, because it talks to satellites, not the internet. You just might not be able to load the map.

shots.scene_description: Satellites beaming location to a phone
Blank map screen with a pin, LOADING...

beats.narration: Old-fashioned phone calls and texts would mostly still work, and so would emergency numbers.

shots.scene_description: Phone ringing with a text bubble
Ambulance light flashing, EMERGENCY CALLS WORK

beats.narration: Businesses, banks, and airlines would freeze, and the world could lose billions of dollars every single day.

shots.scene_description: Airport board: every flight CANCELLED
Money counter dropping, coins falling

beats.narration: And here's the crazy part. The internet isn't floating in the sky. Almost all of it travels through cables lying on the bottom of the ocean.

shots.scene_description: Cloud with a question mark, camera dives below the waves
Glowing data cable on the sea floor with fish

beats.narration: So people would do something wild: go outside, read paper maps, and actually talk to each other.

shots.scene_description: Man outside reading a giant paper map
Two people chatting with speech bubbles

beats.narration: And when it finally came back on? Get ready for a whole week of notifications... all at once.

shots.scene_description: Wi-Fi bars filling up, BACK ONLINE
Phone exploding with 9,999+ notifications
